decision: Before play and immediately after each completed set while the match is open
features: Setka v25 prematch features and count of sets won by each player. No point from the current or later set.
selector: Lowest calibration Brier per stage including references; frozen before test
reference: Training frequency for each set score smoothed toward 0.5
validation: Chronological historical replay on previously inspected Setka dates. No live quotes or observations with exchange timestamps.
